name: agent-os-core
description: Agent OS core: capture intent, plan decisions, explain plainly, keep scope, and prove claims. Useful for any agent work, not only code.

interface.longDescription: Captures what is needed and why as a versioned intent, plans decisions and ground truth as a spec with a plain-language summary, explains or shortens text for non-technical readers, keeps work inside its agreed scope, records durable lessons, and requires fresh evidence before any completion claim. Works for product, documentation, and analysis work as well as code.
